help: Instagram handles the newsroom may @mention or invite as collaborator. Only confirmed: true may be used. confidence high = linked from the organisation's own website, our own account, or chosen by Geoffry on a published post; medium = third-party directory only. @mentions may use high or medium; collaborator invites only high. Add how and when each handle was confirmed. Optional "crest" (a brand/crests slug) and "national_team" ({flag, sport}) link a handle to the logos on a card: the gate then requires the caption to @mention every account whose crest or national team appears (Geoffry, 23 Oct 2026: always tag the people affected). "covers": {"sports": [...]} marks a federation (or committee) that is tagged on every feed post of those sports on its page (gate.py, Geoffry 24 Oct 2026).
